sections.text: Continued to POOH with 10 3/4in casing from 334 to 256m. Average pulling speed 8,7 joints/hr
Performed pre-job meeting to change handling gear
Changed handling equipment for 9 5/8in casing

Attempted to break 10 3/4in x 9 5/8in x-over. Not able to set tongs on the x-over due to no handling pup and od of x-over bigger than collar of 10 3/4in. Repositioned x-over below and set lower tong jaws on x-over, confirmed length above 9 5/8in collar is not too long to pick up with elevator. Broke 10 3/4in joint from x-over and l/d x-over together w/ 9 5/8in joint
Changed BX inserts to 9 5/8in

Continued to POOH with 9 5/8in casing from 232 to 0m. Used manual slips. Average pulling speed 7,6 joints/hr, totally pulled 61 joints. Meanwhile finished w/ pumping postflush after batch#3 of drilling slop on f-4. Total drilling slop pumped for batch#3 of 250m3, postflush pumped of 140m3 batch#3), 1000l/min 150bar. Stopped injection for 2 hours
Cleaned and cleared rig floor
Performed pre-job meeting to r/d casing tong
R/d casing tong
Performed pre-job meeting to m/u combined cutter/ezsv plug BHA
P/u cutting assy and broke off taper mill. M/u m/u combined cutter/ezsv plug BHA
Removed master bushing, installed drill pipe slips

RIH w/ combined cutter/ezsv plug BHA from 13 m to 878 m Average tripping speed 500 m/hr. Meanwhile continued w/ pumping drilling slop batch#4 on f-4. Total preflush pumped of 70m3 batch#4), 1000l/min 145bar
Set EZSV 877. 5m. Released running tool w/ 25t overpull, tagged plug w/ 10 ton

Established and recorded parameters before cutting casing. 80 RPM 1-6 KNM, 400 l/min 42 bar, 500 l/min 60 bar, 600 l/min 83bar. Cut casing 867. 5m, 80rpm, 22 KNM, 400 l/min 42bar. Observed good indication of cut pressure dropped to 5 bar when cut performed, pulled up 1m and pressure increased to 42bar again. Meanwhile continued w/ pumping drilling slop batch#4 on f-4, started pumping drilling slop, batch#4, 1000l/min 145bar
Flow checked well. Static. Dropped drift inside stand
POOH wet w/ combined cutter/ezsv tool BHA from 868 m to 0 m. Avg. Tripping speed 580 m/hr. Used mud bucket
Removed drill pipe slips, installed master bushing
Broke off and l/d EZSV running tool and x-overs, m/u taper mill to bottom of cutter and l/d cutter asembly
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u perforation BHA Meanwhile changed BX inserts to 4,5in
P/u perforation BHA
RIH w/ perforation BHA from 15 m to 145,5 m shot)

Closed UPR, opened choke. Applied 10 bar on IBOP. Opened IBOP to confirm line up. Filled string. Opened UPR, broke off TDS and dropped 1 3/8 ball in string. M/u TDS. Closed UPR and opened choke. Fired guns with 160 l/min 138 bar. Top shot at 142,5m, bottom shot at 145,5m. Continued to circulate w/ 160l/min 2 bar. No gas observed in returns

Increased pump rate to 1000l/min. Pressure went up to 25 bar and then dropped and stabilized at 4 bar. Circulated 1x bu, observed small losses, quickly stabilized, gas reading close to 0 in fluid and no readings in air. Stoped pumps

Flowchecked well over the choke for 15 min. Stable. Open UPR, flow checked well with BOP open, stable. Meanwhile finished w/ pumping postflush after batch#4 of drilling slop on f-4. Total drilling slop pumped for batch#4 of 220m3, postflush pumped of 140m3 batch#4), 1000l/min 145bar. Stopped injection
POOH w/ perforation BHA from 146 m to 15 m
L/d perforation BHA All shots fired
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u EZSV assembly
P/u EZSV assembly
P/u 2x 3m pup joints and 1x 1. 5m pup joint for spaceout and RIH w/ EZSV assembly to 845m. Average running speed 480m/hour
M/u side entry sub assembly
M/u TDS and recorded weights up/down 98t/91t. Washed setting area w/ l/min. Set EZSV plug at 855,3m, tagged plug w/ 10t and keep 10t weight on EZSV
Closed UPR, confirmed line up through the choke and MGS

Pumped 10m3 hi-vis pill at 900l/min 14bar, continued to displace c-annulus to sea water, staged up pumps to 1700l/min 38bar. MAX gas 2,6 1-2 ppm h2s in fluid. Oil base mud in returns initially and sea water towards the end. Totally sea water pumped of 1,4x bu
Opened UPR and closed choke, flow checked the well. Stable. Meanwhile held TBT before cement job
Connected cement hose and LT valve
Pumped 20m3 wash pill ahead of cement job, 1300l/min 13,4bar. Verified line up for cement job
